name: dt_design_B1

slot.where: design option B, key screen B1

subject: repaint this greybox frame as a finished game screen: Tall ochre and cream old-town fronts with calm sash windows, and along their ground floor a continuous granite portico of round arches on piers, its flat top a walkway with a low parapet; the dog walks on it; the portico steps up from the bakery's end to a loggia section over a bronze statue with a cat on its arm; no balconies or rails on the walls near the walkway. The eye should read: one stone line to walk along, the walls are only a backdrop.
extra: Stockholm old town (Gamla stan: ochre, oxblood, cream plaster, red clay tile and grey lead roofs, granite), big readable masses, one strong silhouette line, decoration quieter than the route, late morning light from the upper left, full local colour. No people other than the dog. The grey and flat-colour shapes of the frame are binding geometry: keep what is walkable exactly where it is and at that height.
